title: Two-dimensional steady wake behind a circular obstacle, Re=100: cross-solver adjudication of the force coefficient, the surface pressure distribution and the energy ledger
injected_by: config (the gate code carries no domain vocabulary)

quantities.name: cd
quantities.description: non-dimensional streamwise force coefficient on the obstacle, based on projected height and free-stream dynamic head
quantities.reference_source: Dennis & Chang (1970) J. Fluid Mech. 42:471 -- grid-converged steady solution at Re=100, C_D = 1.34

profiles.name: cp_surface
profiles.description: surface pressure coefficient against arc length measured from the upstream stagnation point, normalised by the obstacle height

energy.description: steady state: the power the mean flow delivers through the body force equals the viscous dissipation integrated over the domain; both terms are non-dimensionalised with rho=U=D=1, so power_in = cd/2 and dissipation = (1/Re) * integral of enstrophy
